reviewerNote: The reviewer did not write or edit these articles. Steps were scripted from the current article text in walkthrough-r2-1.mjs (adapted from walkthrough-r1.mjs) and run in headless Playwright Chromium, one browser context per identity. API calls prepared named records or confirmed saved state; the reader actions used the visible controls. Credentials, sign-in links and tokens were held in memory or in the shell environment only.

labs.used: authentication-and-email (V-C37), and the no-saved-name branding and last-Administrator checks of organisation-and-users

steps.action: Unauthorized administration: open Settings General and Users as a Legal Team Member
steps.expected: Redirected away; the users and invite APIs refuse
steps.actual: Settings General and Users redirected Nadia to /settings/profile. GET /api/v1/users answered 403; POST /api/v1/auth/invites answered 403.

steps.action: Update organization details: Organization name saves on Enter, Escape restores, reload keeps the saved value
steps.expected: Saved status; Escape restores the previous name before saving; value survives reload
steps.actual: Enter showed Saved and "DOC-029r2 admin-org Helix mu4ewcod" survived reload. Escape put the saved name back in the field, and after reload the saved name was still "DOC-029r2 admin-org Helix mu4ewcod".

steps.action: Logo: Upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG of 5 MB or smaller; any other file shows the rejection message; retry
steps.expected: Text file and a PNG over 5 MB show the 5 MB message and change nothing; a 300 KB PNG and an SVG save
steps.actual: A .txt file and a PNG of just over 5 MB each showed "That logo must be a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG image 5 MB or smaller. Pick another file." and left the logo unchanged. A 300 KB PNG then showed Saved and was stored as a PNG data URI (409718 characters). An SVG showed Saved and, after reload, was displayed beside Logo.

steps.action: The saved Organization name and logo appear on the staff and Business Portal sign-in pages without an account
steps.expected: Both pages show the saved name and an Organization logo image
steps.actual: In a browser with no session, /auth/login began "DOC-029r2 admin-org Helix mu4ewcod Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Sign in Email Password Sign in Set up or reset your p" with 1 image named Organization logo; /portal/login began "DOC-029r2 admin-org Helix mu4ewcod Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Business Portal sign-in Email Password Sign in Set up" with 1 such image.

steps.action: Restore the organization name and logo; the sign-in pages follow
steps.expected: Original name saved by leaving the field; logo restored; sign-in pages show the original name and no logo
steps.actual: Typing "Helix Software Group" and leaving the field showed Saved and survived reload. The original logo (none) was restored through PATCH /api/v1/org/general (200) because the pane has no remove control. /auth/login then showed "Helix Software Group Legal Portal Powered by OpenLaw Sign in Email Password Sign" with 0 logo images.

steps.action: Default timezone saves and survives reload; Default locale offers English (United States) only
steps.expected: Timezone saved; one locale option
steps.actual: Default timezone saved America/Toronto and kept it after reload. Default locale offered only ["English (United States)"]. The timezone was restored to Europe/London.

steps.action: Invite a colleague: Invite user with Display name, Email, and Role Legal team member
steps.expected: Role offers Legal team member and Administrator; Send invite adds an Invited row with Resend invite and Revoke invite; email arrives
steps.actual: Role radios were ["Legal team member","Administrator"]. After Send invite the row read Invited with actions ["Resend invite","Revoke invite"] and no role control. Mailpit received "Set your OpenLaw password" with a set-password link.

steps.action: Invalid address is rejected
steps.expected: No row is created for an invalid address
steps.actual: The dialog stayed open with the browser message "Please include an '@' in the email address. 'doc029r2-org-invalid-address' is missing an '@'." and no row was added. The same invite route refused a malformed address with 400.

steps.action: Re-invite the pending address with the same role
steps.expected: The invitation is resent; no duplicate row
steps.actual: The dialog closed, a new "Set your OpenLaw password" email arrived, and the table still had exactly 1 row for the address.

steps.action: Re-invite the pending address with a different role
steps.expected: Refused because the account already exists; no email
steps.actual: The dialog showed "This user already exists with a different role." and no email was sent.

steps.action: Invite an already activated account
steps.expected: Refused
steps.actual: The dialog showed "This user has already activated their account.".

steps.action: Resend invite from the pending row
steps.expected: A replacement link is emailed
steps.actual: The row showed Saved and a new "Set your OpenLaw password" email arrived. Its link is the latest one and is used for activation below.

steps.action: A magic-link sign-in alone does not activate the invited row
steps.expected: The colleague signs in; the row stays Invited with Resend invite and Revoke invite
steps.actual: The staff sign-in page sent "Sign in to OpenLaw". Opening the link signed the colleague in (landed on /; /api/v1/me 200). Daniel's Users table still showed the row as Invited with ["Resend invite","Revoke invite"] and no role control.

steps.action: Set a password from the latest invitation link; the row becomes Active
steps.expected: Password set; row Active with role control
steps.actual: "Password set" appeared and the colleague signed in with the new password. The row read Active with a role control and actions ["Legal team member","Sign out user","Archive"].

steps.action: The activated Legal team member checks their access
steps.expected: No administration: Users redirects and there is no Invite user
steps.actual: Settings Users redirected to /settings/profile; no Invite user control was offered.

steps.action: Revoke invite withdraws an unused invitation
steps.expected: The pending row is removed
steps.actual: The Invited row for Bryn disappeared after Revoke invite, and GET /api/v1/users no longer listed the address.

steps.action: Change a role: promote the colleague to Administrator; the change applies on their next action
steps.expected: Role control offers three roles; colleague gains administration without signing in again
steps.actual: The role menu offered ["Administrator","Legal team member","Business user"]. Choosing Administrator showed Saved and the reloaded row read Administrator. The colleague's existing session opened Settings Users on its next navigation without signing in again.

steps.action: Change the role back to Legal team member
steps.expected: The colleague loses administration on the next request
steps.actual: The row saved Legal team member. The colleague's same session got 403 from GET /api/v1/users on its next request.

steps.action: Promote a Portal-created Business User with no password: the row becomes Invited without a role control
steps.expected: Invited row; Resend invite emails a link; setting a password returns Active with role control
steps.actual: The Portal sign-in link created an Active Business user row with a role control. Inviting that address as a Legal team member was refused with "This user already exists with a different role.". Promoting it to Legal team member turned the row Invited with ["Resend invite","Revoke invite"] and no role control. Resend invite sent "Set your OpenLaw password"; after the password was set the row read Active with its role control back.

steps.action: Return the activated account to Business user, then promote again
steps.expected: An already activated account stays Active and keeps its role control
steps.actual: Returned to Business user the row stayed Active with a role control. Promoted again it stayed Active with its role control, as the article's "If it still reads Active" branch says. It was left as a Business user.

steps.action: Your own row has no Sign out user or Archive action; self-archive is refused
steps.expected: No row actions on Daniel's row; API refuses self archive
steps.actual: Daniel's own row had a role control and no Sign out user or Archive action (buttons: ["Administrator"]). A direct archive request for his own account was refused with 409: "You cannot archive yourself.".

steps.action: Sign out user ends the colleague's sessions; the account stays active and can sign in again
steps.expected: Colleague's next request needs sign-in; row Active; password sign-in works
steps.actual: The visible action label was "Sign out user". The colleague's session went from 200 to 401 on /api/v1/me and the app sent it to /auth/login. The row stayed Active, and a password sign-in worked again (200).

steps.action: Archiving does not bulk-reassign work: a Contract keeps its Owner
steps.expected: The archived person stays the Contract Owner until someone reassigns it
steps.actual: Created Contract 53 with the colleague as Legal Owner (prepared through the API; the check follows in the archive step).

steps.action: Archive the colleague: the row leaves the ordinary list, sessions end, sign-in is blocked
steps.expected: Row hidden; live session ends; password sign-in refused; Contract Owner unchanged
steps.actual: Archive removed the row from the ordinary list at once. The colleague's live session went from 200 to 401. A new password sign-in showed "This account has been archived.". Contract 53 still named the archived colleague as Legal Owner (archived: true); nothing was reassigned.

steps.action: Show archived, Restore, and ask the user to sign in again
steps.expected: Restored row Active; the revoked session stays revoked; a new sign-in works
steps.actual: With Show archived on, the row read Archived with a Restore action. Restore showed Saved and the row read Active. The old browser session still got 401; a fresh password sign-in got 200.

retainedRuns.phase: stored: SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM empty for app and worker (overlay-phase-stored.json)

steps.action: First-run: create the first Administrator; the wizard needs email before it can finish
steps.expected: Welcome wizard opens; Skip optional steps on Welcome opens Outbound email while email is unset; no Set up later; Continue unavailable
steps.actual: The first Administrator was created and landed on /welcome. Skip optional steps on the Welcome step opened Outbound email (/welcome?step=email) with "Set up outbound email to finish instance setup...". The step had no Set up later (buttons ["Save relay","Back","Continue"]) and Continue was disabled.

steps.action: With no saved Organization name, the sign-in pages show OpenLaw
steps.expected: Staff and Portal sign-in pages show OpenLaw and no logo
steps.actual: On the unseeded lab the organization had no saved name (GET /api/v1/org/branding {"name":"","logo":null}). In a browser with no session: {"/auth/login":{"start":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Sign in Email Password Sign in Help wit","logos":0},"/portal/login":{"start":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Business Portal sign-in Email Password ","logos":0}}.

steps.action: Outbound email form: Port starts at 587 and follows Connection security until changed; Authentication shows or hides SMTP username and SMTP password
steps.expected: 587, 465 for TLS, 25 for None, back to 587; a changed port stays; credentials fields only with Username and password
steps.actual: Observed {"initial":"587","securityOptions":["STARTTLS","TLS","None"],"authenticationOptions":["Username and password","None"],"initialAuthentication":"Username and password","tls":"465","none":"25","starttls":"587","changedThenTls":"2525","credentialsWithPassword":[1,1],"credentialsWithNone":[0,0]}. The page was reloaded afterwards and stayed on Outbound email.

steps.action: SMTP server with an smtp:// prefix or a port is refused
steps.expected: Not saved; source stays unset
steps.actual: Save relay results: [{"host":"smtp://mailpit","notice":null,"alerts":["One or more request fields are invalid."],"source":"unset"},{"host":"mailpit:1025","notice":null,"alerts":["One or more request fields are invalid."],"source":"unset"}].

steps.action: Save relay with STARTTLS and Username and password; credentials are never returned; the test fails because the relay offers no TLS upgrade
steps.expected: Relay saved; the page and API show no credentials; stored value is not plain text; Send test email fails and nothing is delivered
steps.actual: Save relay showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.". The step read "Outbound email is set in the app. Mail is sent from "DOC-029r2 Stored" <stored-relay@helix.example>.". GET /api/v1/email-settings returned only ["source","fromAddress"] ({"source":"app","fromAddress":"\"DOC-029r2 Stored\" <stored-relay@helix.example>"}); neither the page nor the API contained the SMTP username or password. The org_settings.smtp_url column held a 199-character value that did not contain the host, username or password in plain text. Send test email against Mailpit, which offers no STARTTLS, showed "The test email could not be sent. A secure connection could not be established. Check the connection security setting and the relay's TLS certificate." and Mailpit received 0 messages.

steps.action: Replace relay opens an empty form; Keep current relay closes it without a change; replace with None and None and send a test
steps.expected: Empty form; Keep current relay leaves the relay unchanged; Relay saved; test message arrives from the Sender email with the Sender name
steps.actual: Replace relay opened {"host":"","port":"587","security":"STARTTLS","authentication":"Username and password","username":"","password":"","senderName":"","senderEmail":""}. Keep current relay closed the form and the settings stayed {"source":"app","fromAddress":"\"DOC-029r2 Stored\" <stored-relay@helix.example>"}. Replace relay with SMTP server mailpit, Port 1025, Connection security None, Authentication None, Sender email stored-relay@helix.example and Sender name DOC-029r2 Stored showed "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it." and "Outbound email is set in the app. Mail is sent from "DOC-029r2 Stored" <stored-relay@helix.example>.". Send test email showed "Test email sent to doc029-auth-admin@helix.example. Check your inbox." and Mailpit received "OpenLaw test email" from DOC-029r2 Stored <stored-relay@helix.example>. Continue became available.

steps.action: Replace relay with a server that cannot be reached; the saved relay fails its test; Replace relay again with all details and retest
steps.expected: Relay saved alone does not prove delivery; the corrected relay delivers
steps.actual: An unreachable SMTP server saved with "Relay saved. The next email this instance sends will use it.", but Send test email showed "The test email could not be sent. The relay host could not be found. Check the SMTP server name.". Replace relay, all details entered again, Save relay, and a second test delivered "OpenLaw test email" from stored-relay@helix.example.

steps.action: Clear relay stops email delivery when there is no environment override; save a valid replacement
steps.expected: Source unset, Continue unavailable, no mail; saved replacement restores delivery
steps.actual: Clear relay showed "Relay cleared. This instance can no longer send email." The source became unset and Continue was disabled again. A password setup request for the Administrator answered 503 and no message arrived. After a valid replacement was saved, a test message arrived again from stored-relay@helix.example.

retainedRuns.phase: env: SMTP_URL smtp://mailpit:1025 and SMTP_FROM DOC-029 Environment <env-relay@helix.example> (overlay-phase-env.json), stored relay still saved

steps.action: Deployment sets SMTP_URL and SMTP_FROM: the wizard relay settings are read-only and the environment wins
steps.expected: No Save relay, Replace relay or Clear relay; mail is sent from the environment sender, not the stored one
steps.actual: The Outbound email step read "Outbound email is set by the deployment environment. Mail is sent from DOC-029 Environment <env-relay@helix.example>." with the hint that settings saved here never apply. Its buttons were ["Back","Continue"]; there was no Save relay, Replace relay, Clear relay or Send test email. A direct save attempt answered 409. An invitation from the Invite your team step arrived from env-relay@helix.example, not from the stored stored-relay@helix.example.

retainedRuns.phase: incomplete: SMTP_URL set, SMTP_FROM empty (overlay-phase-incomplete.json), complete stored relay still saved

steps.action: SMTP_URL without SMTP_FROM prevents delivery even though a complete relay is stored in the app
steps.expected: Warning shown; no message is sent
steps.actual: The step warned "The deployment environment sets SMTP_URL but not SMTP_FROM, so mail cannot be sent. Set SMTP_FROM in the environment." The source was env with from null. Continue was disabled, so the invite step could not be reached. A direct invitation through the Users invite route answered 201, and Mailpit received 0 messages for that address.

retainedRuns.phase: stored again: override removed and app and worker recreated (overlay-phase-stored.json)

steps.action: Remove the environment override and restart: the stored relay is active again
steps.expected: Step reads set in the app; test mail from the stored sender
steps.actual: After the override was removed, the step read "Outbound email is set in the app. Mail is sent from DOC-029r2 Stored <stored-relay@helix.example>." and a test message arrived from stored-relay@helix.example.

steps.action: Replace relay with an SMTP server that includes a port; the stored relay stays active; Keep current relay
steps.expected: The save is refused; the stored relay stays active
steps.actual: Saving SMTP server mailpit:1025 did not save ({"match":null,"alerts":["One or more request fields are invalid."]}); the source stayed app from "DOC-029r2 Stored" <stored-relay@helix.example>. Keep current relay closed the form, and a test message still arrived from stored-relay@helix.example.

steps.action: Finish the wizard; it cannot be reopened and there is no separate email Settings page
steps.expected: Welcome redirects after completion; Settings has no email page
steps.actual: Set up later on the remaining optional steps and Finish completed the wizard. Opening /welcome again went to /. The Settings rail read "Personal Profile Appearance Notifications View Business Portal Organization General Regions Departments Users Security Authentication Audit log Matters Contracts Intake Entities Knowledge Auto-Docs Notifications AI analysis Integrations" with no email entry; /settings/email showed "Personal Profile Appearance Notifications View Business Portal Organization General Regions Departments Users Security M".

steps.action: Prepare staff: invite a Legal Team Member who sets a password, and two colleagues who stay invited
steps.expected: Rows exist with the expected status
steps.actual: Rows: {"doc029-auth-legal@helix.example":"Active","doc029-auth-sso@helix.example":"Invited","doc029-auth-staff@elsewhere.example":"Invited"}.

steps.action: Open Settings, Security, Authentication: two policy cards with four switches; SSO unavailable before a provider is registered
steps.expected: Legal User Authentication and Business Portal Authentication cards; Single sign-on (SSO) disabled
steps.actual: Settings rail Security expanded to Authentication. Switches: {"Legal User Authentication":["Email and password:true","Email magic link:true","Single sign-on (SSO):false:disabled","Require two-factor authentication:false"],"Business Portal Authentication":["Email and password:true","Email magic link:true","Single sign-on (SSO):false:disabled","Require two-factor authentication:false"]}.

steps.action: Allowed email domains: Add an approved domain and check the saved list
steps.expected: Saved; survives reload
steps.actual: The empty list read "No domains allowed yet. Magic-link sign-in is unavailable." After Add, northwind.example appeared with a "Remove northwind.example" control and stayed after reload (["northwind.example"]).

steps.action: A policy with no sign-in method is refused
steps.expected: Enable at least one sign-in method.
steps.actual: Turning off Email magic link showed "Saved". Turning off Email and password as the last method showed "Enable at least one sign-in method." and the stored Legal policy kept password on. Email magic link was turned back on ("Saved").

steps.action: Emergency password sign-in: Email and password off under Legal User Authentication
steps.expected: An Administrator with a password still signs in; a Legal Team Member cannot
steps.actual: With Email and password off ("Saved"), the Administrator signed in with a password (me 200, role administrator). The Legal Team Member with a password was refused (Password sign-in is disabled for this account.; me 401). Email and password was turned back on.

steps.action: Email magic link under Legal User Authentication: existing staff get a link even when their domain is not allowed
steps.expected: Staff on helix.example and elsewhere.example receive links; an invited staff row stays Invited after magic-link sign-in
steps.actual: Allowed domains held only northwind.example. doc029-auth-legal@helix.example: link received, me 200 role legal_team_member; doc029-auth-staff@elsewhere.example: link received, me 200 role legal_team_member. The off-domain colleague's row still read Invited after the magic-link sign-in.

steps.action: New Portal entrant on an allowed domain gets a link; an unapproved address gets no link or password setup link
steps.expected: Allowed address becomes a Business User; unapproved address gets no mail and no account
steps.actual: doc029-auth-portal-mu4fei1r@northwind.example got "Sign in to OpenLaw", opened the Portal and is a business_user. doc029-auth-unapproved-mu4fei1r@unlisted.example saw the neutral "Check your email" and password-setup confirmations, but Mailpit received 0 messages and no account exists.

steps.action: A Business User sets a password through the Portal password setup link and signs in with Email and password
steps.expected: Password setup email; password sign-in reaches the Portal
steps.actual: "Set your OpenLaw password" arrived, the password was set, and Email and password sign-in on the Portal page reached /portal/onboarding as business_user.

steps.action: Remove the domain: no new links for anyone on it, but existing access continues as the article describes
steps.expected: Existing Business User gets no new link; held session, earlier link, and password sign-in still work; new-address setup refused at completion; staff unaffected
steps.actual: After Remove northwind.example the list read "No domains allowed yet...". Observed: {"newLinkMails":0,"heldSession":200,"earlierLink":"/portal/onboarding me 200","passwordSignIn":"me 200 business_user","lateCompletion":"OpenLaw Legal Portal Set your password At least 8 characters. Password setup is no longer available for this address. New password Confirm password Set password Help with this page","staffLink":true,"lateAccount":false}. The domain was added back.

steps.action: Turn off Email magic link under Business Portal Authentication: earlier links stop working and the Portal page offers other methods
steps.expected: Earlier link refused; no magic-link choice on the Portal page; password sign-in still works
steps.actual: Turning off Email magic link showed "Saved". Opening the link sent before the change stayed on /api/auth/magic-link/verify, which answered "{"message":"This sign-in method is disabled for your account.","code":"SIGN_IN_METHOD_DISABLED"}", with no session (me 401). The Portal sign-in page offered ["Sign in","Set up or reset your password"], with no magic-link choice. The Business User with a password still signed in (me 200). Email magic link was turned back on.

steps.action: Register provider with an issuer that cannot be reached
steps.expected: Refused; nothing registered
steps.actual: Register provider with an unreachable issuer showed "The change could not be saved. Try again." and no provider was stored.

steps.action: Register provider against the local OpenID Connect fixture; copy the callback URL; registration turns on nothing
steps.expected: Saved; callback ends /api/auth/sso/callback on the instance address; SSO switches stay off; Provider ID fixed
steps.actual: Register provider showed Saved and "Paste this callback URL into your IdP console: http://127.0.0.1:23310/api/auth/sso/callback". Both Single sign-on (SSO) switches stayed off but became available (["false","false"]). After reload the Provider ID field was gone and the button read Save provider.

steps.action: Turn on Single sign-on (SSO) under Legal User Authentication; an invited staff account signs in through the identity provider
steps.expected: Callback succeeds; role Legal team member retained; row becomes Active
steps.actual: The switch saved ("Saved"). In a separate browser, Continue with single sign-on went through the fixture's authorize endpoint and the OpenLaw callback to /, signed in as legal_team_member. The invited row now read Active with a role control (true).

steps.action: An uninvited identity on a matching email domain gets no staff role
steps.expected: No staff session; no staff account
steps.actual: With Business Portal single sign-on off, doc029-auth-uninvited-mu4ff2mk@helix.example (matching the provider's helix.example domain, not an allowed Portal domain) ended on /auth/login?error=sso with me 401 and "Single sign-on failed. Try again.". Account created: none.

steps.action: Save provider with Client secret left blank, then with a replacement secret; test a fresh sign-in after each
steps.expected: Saved both times; staff SSO still works
steps.actual: The Client secret hint read "Leave blank to keep the current secret. Paste a new value to rotate." Saving a Client ID change with a blank secret showed Saved; a fresh staff SSO sign-in worked (me 200). Saving a replacement secret showed Saved; another fresh sign-in worked (me 200). Stored client ID: doc029-client-mu4ff2mk.

steps.action: Update the issuer to one that cannot be reached
steps.expected: Refused; the previous provider stays usable
steps.actual: Save provider with an unreachable issuer showed "The change could not be saved. Try again.". The stored issuer stayed http://oidc:8080 and a fresh staff SSO sign-in still worked (me 200).

steps.action: Turn on Single sign-on (SSO) under Business Portal Authentication; an existing Business User signs in through the identity provider, and still can after the domain is removed
steps.expected: Existing Business User on the provider's email domain enters the Portal before and after narrowing the list; no staff role is granted
steps.actual: helix.example was added, and doc029-auth-bu-mu4ff2mk@helix.example entered the Portal through a sign-in link. The Business Portal SSO switch saved ("Saved"). Portal single sign-on for that existing Business User reached /portal/onboarding as business_user. After Remove helix.example (list now ["northwind.example"]), the same identity still signed in through single sign-on (/portal/onboarding, business_user). A never-seen identity on the removed domain ended on /portal/login?error=sso with "Single sign-on failed. Try again." and no account was created.

steps.action: Recover: Administrator password sign-in with Email and password off under Legal, then turn on Email and password and turn off SSO
steps.expected: Admin password sign-in works; staff login returns to password; SSO off
steps.actual: With only Single sign-on (SSO) on for Legal users ({"password":false,"magicLink":false,"sso":true,"requireTwoFactor":false}), the Administrator still signed in with a password (me 200). Turning Email and password and Email magic link back on and SSO off in both cards gave {"legal":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false},"business":{"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}}, and the Legal Team Member signed in with a password again (me 200).

steps.action: Turn on Require two-factor authentication under Legal User Authentication as an Administrator with no authenticator; OpenLaw asks for set-up before continuing
steps.expected: The switch leads to enrolment with the organization requirement; API calls are refused until enrolment; enrolment then reaches the app
steps.actual: Require two-factor authentication was off ({"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}). Selecting it under Legal User Authentication saved it on and took the Administrator straight to /auth/two-factor/enroll with "Your organization requires two-factor authentication."; an admin API call answered 403 ("Set up two-factor authentication before continuing."). After Turn on two-factor, a code, Confirm and Done, the Administrator reached / and the same API answered 200.

steps.action: Each new session must prove a code
steps.expected: A fresh password sign-in asks for a code
steps.actual: A fresh password sign-in went to /auth/two-factor with "Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app." Before the code /api/v1/me answered 401; after Verify it answered 200.

steps.action: Required two-factor applies to email magic links too
steps.expected: A Legal Team Member without an authenticator is sent to set one up after a magic-link sign-in
steps.actual: After the magic-link sign-in the Legal Team Member was sent to /auth/two-factor/enroll; /api/v1/me reported setup required (true), and a work API call (/api/v1/matters) answered 403.

steps.action: Turn off Require two-factor authentication
steps.expected: Policy saved off
steps.actual: The switch saved off ({"password":true,"magicLink":true,"sso":false,"requireTwoFactor":false}). The Administrator's own authenticator stays enrolled.

steps.action: Last Administrator safeguard: the only Administrator cannot be demoted
steps.expected: Refused with a message
steps.actual: On the owned lab, where DOC-029r2 admin-org Auth Admin is the only active Administrator (1), choosing Legal team member on the own row showed "You cannot demote the last Administrator." and the role stayed administrator. Archiving the same account through the API was refused with 409 ("You cannot archive the last Administrator.").

steps.action: Turn on Require two-factor authentication as an Administrator who has no authenticator
steps.expected: OpenLaw asks that Administrator to set one up before continuing
steps.actual: The Legal Team Member was temporarily made an Administrator. In their own session, selecting Require two-factor authentication under Legal User Authentication took them straight to /auth/two-factor/enroll with "Your organization requires two-factor authentication." The enrolled Administrator then turned the switch off ("Saved") and returned the colleague to Legal team member.

steps.action: OpenLaw checks the account's actual role, whichever sign-in page the person opened
steps.expected: With Legal password sign-in off, a Legal Team Member is refused on the Portal page too; a Business User with a password can use the staff page
steps.actual: With Email and password off under Legal User Authentication, the Legal Team Member's password sign-in on the Business Portal page was refused (Password sign-in is disabled for this account.; me 401). With Business Portal password sign-in on, the Business User's password sign-in on the staff page succeeded (me 200, business_user, landed /portal/onboarding). Legal password sign-in was turned back on.

steps.action: An identity with no account is refused when it first redeems a link issued before its domain was removed
steps.expected: No session and no account
